reference: There is no matching GNU/POSIX NTP CLI in the source build; the status catalog lists chronyc/ntpd as missing. The runnable contract cases use Bash's documented type -t and help builtins and check the registered ntp_doc surface from the pinned source. Protocol behavior is deferred instead of being represented as GNU parity or inferred from candidate output.
coverage: Executed coverage is Bash availability/help metadata only; no operational behavior is counted as a pass.
Bash reports ntp as a builtin through type -t.
Bash help exposes the documented query, sync, run and serve synopsis and selected safety/configuration contracts.
exclusions: No parity case is claimed because the loadable has no matching GNU/POSIX command-line implementation.
No network operation is executed in this suite, including loopback traffic.
No clock-setting or clock-discipline operation is executed.
No NTS self-test is run because its success marker is not part of the documented help contract and its internal verifier is not an independent oracle.
Refclock device, physical timing, kernel discipline and live time-server behavior require later disposable VM or syscall-mock qualification.

cases.purpose: Confirm Bash classifies the loadable command as a builtin, using the documented type -t contract without invoking an NTP operation.
Check Bash help metadata contains the documented subcommand synopsis, dry-run promise and config keys without opening sockets or changing time.
cases.script:
doc=$(help ntp)
[[ $doc == *"ntp query SERVER [-t MS] [-p PORT]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"ntp sync [-s SERVER]... [-t MS] [-n] [-l LIMIT] [-P POLLS]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"ntp run [-d STATEDIR] [-i SECS] [-c CONFIG] [--once]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"ntp serve [-S ADDR[:PORT]] [--stratum N] [--refid STR]"* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"--dry-run-discipline prints the would-apply action and mutates no clock."* ]] || exit 1
[[ $doc == *"Config keys: server <host|nts:host>, interval <sec>, retry <sec>,"* ]] || exit 1
printf '%s\n' 'ntp documented help surface present'

cases.purpose: Exercise query request/reply matching and the normal, alarm, KoD, malformed-response and timeout paths.
Verify multi-server offset aggregation, panic/clamp boundaries and the documented -n applied=no result.
Check a serve response's mode/version/leap/stratum/refid and timestamp fields against a fixed client request.
Check config parsing, cfg/last state records, one-shot completion and the documented dry-run discipline output.
Verify the NTS-KE negotiation, cookie handling and authenticated NTP response path against independently generated protocol fixtures.
cases.reason: No executed fixture provides an NTS-KE TLS server and an NTS-authenticated NTP UDP responder. The candidate's ntp query passes no CA path to bc_nts_ke_run, so trust must come from the system bundle, which a fixture must override privately.
